title: WebSocket Game Server
description: Build a multiplayer game server with REST endpoints for creating, joining, making moves, and checking game state and leaderboard.

steps.title: Create a game
steps.description: Create a POST /game/create endpoint that creates a new game and returns 201 with a gameId.
hints: Initialize game state with empty players array and default score
Return the gameId in the response

steps.title: Join a game
steps.description: Create a POST /game/:id/join endpoint that adds a player to the game.
hints: Accept player name in the request body
Add player to the game's players array

steps.title: Make a move
steps.description: Create a POST /game/:id/move endpoint that records a player's move in the game.
hints: Accept player name and move data in request body
Push the move to the game's moves array

steps.title: Get game state
steps.description: Add a GET /game/:id/state endpoint that returns the current game state including players and scores.
hints: Return the full game object as JSON

steps.title: Get game leaderboard
steps.description: Add a GET /game/:id/leaderboard endpoint that returns players sorted by score in descending order.
hints: Sort players by their scores in descending order
Return array of { player, score } objects
